title: Colours for Direct2D
description:
Convert colours to Direct2D's floating-point form, with premultiplied alpha.

```
#FF8800 -> ColorF(1.000, 0.533, 0.000, 1.000)
#FF880080 -> straight (1.000, 0.533, 0.000, 0.502), premultiplied (0.502, 0.268, 0.000, 0.502)
0xRRGGBB value 0x336699 -> (0.200, 0.400, 0.600)
```
hints: `std::stoul(hex.substr(1), nullptr, 16)` reads the whole number; then take bytes out with shifts (lesson 4.02).
For 6 digits the alpha is 255; for 8, it is the lowest byte.
requirements: Premultiplied means each colour channel times alpha, which is what D2D bitmaps store.
stretch: Blend two colours "over" each other with premultiplied maths.
